messages.content: 你能預測一間面積為2500平方英呎、有3間房間、建於2000年、位於紐約的房屋價格，並將其與一間類似的房屋但面積為3000平方英呎、建於2005年、位於洛杉磯的房屋價格進行比較嗎？最後，預測一間面積為2000平方英呎、有2間房間、建於1995年、位於芝加哥的第三間房屋的價格。

function.name: predict_house_price
function.description: Predict house price based on area, number of rooms and year of construction. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

area.description: Area of the house in square feet.

rooms.description: Number of rooms in the house.

year.description: Year when the house was constructed.

location.description: The location or city of the house.

message.reasoning:
The user wants predictions for three houses:

1. House A: area=2500 sqft, rooms=3, year=2000, location=New York
2. House B: area=3000 sqft, rooms=?, year=2005, location=Los Angeles. Wait, they didn't specify rooms for B. They said "a similar house but area 3000 sqft, built 2005, located Los Angeles". They didn't give rooms. We might assume same number of rooms? But they didn't specify. We need to ask for clarification. The user also wants to compare the prices of A and B. Then predict price for House C: area=2000 sqft, rooms=2, year=1995, location=Chicago.

We have a function predict_house_price that takes area, rooms, year, location. For House B we don't know rooms. So we should ask for clarification. Also we need to call the function for each house after we get all needed info.

Thus we should respond asking for clarification about the number of rooms for House B.
